🤖 AI Platform AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 1h ago • Taste-Bench reveals even top AI models pick correct long-term strategy choices only ~60% of the time. • Extended reasoning and longer thinking don't improve AI agents' strategic decision-making performance. • New benchmark highlights fundamental weakness in AI long-term planning beyond simple binary decisions.
